+	return &Job{
+		id:        id,
+		createdBy: createdBy,
+		startedAt: time.Now().UTC(),
+		cancel:    cancelFunc,
+		cmd:       cmd,
+		stdErr:    stdErr,
+		stdOut:    stdOut,
+		command:   command,
+		arguments: arguments,
+		kill:      true,

+# Linux Worker 
+
+A linux worker service that will spawn arbitrary processes on a linux machine. In addition to
+the worker library a gRPC API will be provided to remotely spawn jobs.
+
+## Disclaimer
+
+Unprivileged access to a remote machine is a major security vulnerability. While this project
+does not aim to fully isolate the processes spawned or limit the commands/syscalls a user may perform,
+it does aim to provide the building blocks for such a containerized system.
+
+## Worker
+
+The library will spawn child processes via [exec.Cmd](https://golang.org/pkg/os/exec/#Cmd). Prior to launching a process
+the worker will configure [cgroups](https://www.man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/cgroups.7.html) to limit available system resources 
+and [namespaces](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/namespaces.7.html) to perform basic isolation.
+
+### cgroups
+
+The worker library requires **cgroups v2**. 
+
+A cgroup will be set up for each child which can be configured to limit CPU, Memory, and Disk IO.
+
+### Namespaces
+
+New PID, Mount and Networking namespaces will be created by setting the appropriate `SysProcAttr` field of the `exec.Cmd`
+
+```go
+	cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{
+		Cloneflags: syscall.CLONE_NEWNS |
+			syscall.CLONE_NEWPID |
+			syscall.CLONE_NEWNET ,
+```
+
+Setting the `Cloneflags` is however not enough to get everything to work. The library will use [pivot_root](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/pivot_root.2.html) 
+to set a new root filesystem for the child process. To ensure networking is functional the library also will create and set up a bridge device
+in the original host namespace and pair it to the new namespace via a virtual ethernet paired device. 
+
+
+## gRPC API
+
+### Authentication
+
+mTLS will be used as the authentication mechanism for the gRPC server. Only TLS 1.3 will be allowed.
+For this exercise, the identity of the client will be the `Common Name` of the validated
+x.509 certificate used for mTLS. The [certs](certs) directory contains some certificates that have
+already been generated and can be used to test/verify that the authentication and authorization mechanisms
+are functional.
+
+> It is **NOT** recommended that certificates are stored like this for a real production project. They are strictly
+> here for testing and demonstration purposes.
+
+### Authorization
+
+RBAC will be as the authorization mechanism for the gRPC server. The following [Casbin](https://casbin.org) model and 
+policy will be used for authorization. 
+
+###### Model
+```
+[request_definition]
+// requests must contain a subject and an object i.e. alice, Start
+r = sub, obj
+
+[role_definition]
+// an RBAC system that allows for inheritance of roles
+g = _, _     
+
+[policy_definition]
+// a policy must have a subject and an object
+p = sub, obj   
+
+[policy_effect]
+// access is granted if at least one policy allows it
+e = some(where (p.eft == allow))   
+
+[matchers]
+// the subject of the request must have a role in the policy and the object must match
+m = g(r.sub, p.sub) && keyMatch(r.obj, p.obj)
+```
+
+###### Policy
+```csv
+p, role:admin, *
+p, role:user, Status
+p, role:user, Logs
+
+g, alice, role:admin
+g, bob, role:user
+```
+
+### Proto
+
+```protobuf
+syntax = "proto3";
+
+import "google/protobuf/timestamp.proto";
+
+service Worker {
+  rpc Start(StartRequest) returns (StartResponse);
+  rpc Stop(StopRequest) returns (StopResponse);
+  rpc Status(StatusRequest) returns (StatusResponse);
+  rpc Logs(LogRequest) returns(stream LogResponse);
+}
+
+message StartRequest {
+  string command = 1;
+  repeated string arguments = 2;
+}
+
+message StartResponse {
+  string identifier = 1;
+}
+
+message StopRequest {
+  string identifier = 1;
+}
+
+message StopResponse {}
+
+message StatusRequest {
+  string identifier = 1;
+}
+
+message StatusResponse {
+  string created_by = 2;
+  google.protobuf.Timestamp started_at = 3;
+  google.protobuf.Timestamp completed_at = 4;
+  string state = 5;
+  string command = 6;
+  repeated string arguments = 7;
+  int32 exit_code = 8;
+}
+
+message LogRequest {
+  string identifier = 1;
+}
+
+message LogResponse {
+  bytes output = 1;
+}
+```
+
+#### Start
+
+Launches the `command` with the provided `arguments` and returns the unique `identifier` of the job
+
+#### Stop
+
+Stops the job associated with the `identifer` provided if one exists.
